plan_item: 77.44.7.B — WEB-013 published Rich Text anchor extraction, authorization, Save/Publish acceptance

finding.cause: The link-report route used a regex that matched anchor-like text inside comments and script raw-text, yielding false candidates and incorrect checked-link counts.
finding.fix: Use Cloudflare Workers native HTMLRewriter to extract actual a[href] elements; preserve the HTML attribute entity decoder, same-origin/auth checks and field/candidate caps.
finding.platform_test: Miniflare/Workerd test confirms comments, script/style/textarea, data-href, quoted > parsing and candidate truncation.
finding.reuse: Existing Cloudflare HTMLRewriter platform API and entities@8.1.0 BSD-2-Clause already in project; no new dependency.
